data.title: 白夜 · 小屋里的热拉面
data.description: 【白夜 · 小屋里的热拉面】忙完一天的白夜换上宽松的旧运动外套和运动短裤，坐在小公寓的餐桌旁吃晚饭。她一手扶着拉面碗，另一手用筷子夹起面条，小心吹散热气，眼前这顿便宜却热乎的晚餐让她安心下来——「趁热吃吧，今天的汤还挺好喝的。」
data.action: 坐在餐桌前，一手扶碗，另一手用筷子夹起面条并轻轻吹凉
data.promptProse: At a small apartment table, Byakuya sits in her loose vintage track jacket and gym shorts, steadying a ramen bowl with one hand while lifting noodles with chopsticks and blowing gently on them. A warm kitchen lamp lights the rising steam, the simple tabletop and her relaxed face, leaving the rest of the modest room softly shaded.
data.camera: medium shot across the dining table, face, bowl and hands in frame
data.lighting: 小厨房吊灯照亮面碗热气的暖光
